newsitem.title: USA: Japan spokesman--dlr/yen moves follow fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: Japan spokesman--dlr/yen moves follow fundamentals.

text.p: The dollar's drop to a historic low against the yen in 1995 and its subsequent sharp rebound reflect Japanese economic fundamentals, a Japanese government spokesman said.
"Exchange rates reflect the fundamentals of the Japanese economy," said Hiroshi Hashimoto, spokesman for the Japanese delegation at the Group of Seven summit here.
Hashimoto added that the recent dollar pullback from a near five-month high at 127.47 reflected the rebound in Japanese growth to over three percent last year after several years of weakness.
"We hope that we can enjoy that kind of...growth in the future," he said.
